tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile, time
p = Path('api/server.go')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'func (s *Server) Start() {}\\n\\nfunc (s *Server) internalRun() {}\\n'
new = 'func (s *Server) Start() {}\\n\\nfunc InitServer() *Server {\\n\\treturn &Server{}\\n}\\n\\nfunc (s *Server) internalRun() {}\\n'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected insertion point not found')
fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.server.go.', dir=str(p.parent))
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(s.replace(old, new))
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(name, p)
    os.utime(p, ns=(time.time_ns(), time.time_ns()))
except BaseException:
    try: os.unlink(name)
    except FileNotFoundError: pass
    raise
PY
"
